release_notes: Navigation and runner-mechanics revision. Native Home, Team, Routes and Records tabs; three finite expeditions and Endless Relay; interactive guided practice; complete pause/settings/controls/back and results flows; local journal. Tap-to-strike and contextual strike timing, buffered jumping, crouched movement, bounded lane changes and camera tracking, corrected Witch blink, route pacing and authored encounters. Existing saves and signing identity are retained. This remains a development alpha below the final premium production target; physical-phone comfort and performance still need validation.
